task: Implement the MoMorph 'Countdown - Prelaunch page' (screenId 8PJQswPZmU): a /prelaunch route rendering DAYS/HOURS/MINUTES on a 1s tick, plus an app-wide launch-timing gate in proxy.ts that holds every other route until the countdown crosses zero and reverses at T-0.
acceptanceCriteria: /prelaunch renders the title and three countdown units with two digit boxes and an uppercase white label each
countdown values are two-digit zero-padded and update automatically as time passes
while the countdown is above zero every other route redirects to /prelaunch
once the countdown reaches zero the gate opens and /prelaunch redirects to /
a viewer already on /prelaunch when the countdown crosses zero is moved without a reload
a missing or unparseable NEXT_PUBLIC_EVENT_START_AT fails open and locks nothing
every visual value traces to the MoMorph design table rather than an estimate
the pre-existing homepage E2E suite still passes
blastRadius: proxy.ts intercepts EVERY route in the application — the widest possible surface; a matcher mistake would redirect the app's own CSS, font and background image into the gate
the existing homepage E2E suite ran against a future-dated server and had to be re-pointed to a gate-open server once the gate went live
lib/countdown.ts is shared with components/home/countdown-timer.tsx and was deliberately left unchanged
next.config.ts gained a distDir switch, which changed what npm run lint crawls and required an eslint globalIgnores update
app/globals.css is loaded by every route, so the new @font-face affects the whole app
contracts: resolveGateRedirect(pathname, targetIso, now) -> '/prelaunch' | '/' | null, pure with now injected
usePrelaunchCountdown() -> { days, hours, minutes }, SSR value '00'/'00'/'00', 1s tick, fires router.replace('/') at T-0
i18n key prelaunch.title present in both the vi and en dictionaries
